verdict.rationale: Eqvista's support docs include articles on downloading extended and summary cap table reports, so it does document its own export path for the cap table. The evidence never says the format is Excel or CSV, and transaction history appears only as a viewable timeline, not an export. The migration and spreadsheet-import items cover inbound data only, and the PDF download applies to round-modeling analysis, so neither counts toward this story. Missing for 10: confirmed Excel/CSV export format, export of the full transaction history/ledger, evidence that complete data can be exported on any plan at any time, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
